next.reason: 1985: "ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL [ RELATIVE KEY IS data-name-1 ] ... RANDOM/DYNAMIC RELATIVE KEY IS data-name-1"; 2023: "[ ORGANIZATION IS ] RELATIVE [ RELATIVE KEY IS data-name-7 ]; ACCESS MODE IS {SEQUENTIAL|RANDOM|DYNAMIC} separate". Key still required for RANDOM/DYNAMIC, but 2023 makes RELATIVE KEY its own clause, so it can be written without any ACCESS MODE clause; 1985 accepted it only inside ACCESS MODE.
